caption:
From drafting your first biodata to finding a rishta, here is how RishtaPatra helps.

Make your biodata. Match your kundali. Find your rishta.

RishtaPatra brings three products together:
• Biodata maker: Build your biodata on your device for your family.
• Janam Kundali (free): Astrological details at your fingertips.
• Rishta Connect (matchmaking): Find matches where cards display a 36-point Guna Milan score, such as "Guna Milan 22.5/36".

Kundali details are indicative; consult your pandit.

Visit rishtapatra.com to get started.
